verdict.rationale: Replit's own docs include a dedicated 'schedule a routine' page saying a recurring job can become a routine that runs on a schedule and reports back, which directly matches recurring (not one-off) scheduling. Support rests on that single sentence, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: documented schedule granularity and configuration options, run history and failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Turn a recurring job into a routine that runs on a schedule and reports back to you.
